summary: Cumberland Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K on July 1, 2026, reporting the closing of a strategic transaction to sell its commercial products (Acetadote, Caldolor, Kristalose, Sancuso, Vaprisol, Vibativ) and related equity interests to Nuvo Pharmaceuticals and an affiliate of Apotex Inc. under an Asset Purchase Agreement dated April 22, 2026. Cumberland retained its ifetroban product candidates and Cumberland Emerging Technologies. The company terminated and repaid a $5.3 million credit facility. Financial terms, premium, and advisors were not disclosed. The closing occurred July 1, 2026. Watch for future development updates on the retained ifetroban pipeline.
